recap.text: Two of Iota's four nipple rings hold real value, and both are for selling. Carl wears the third, a glowing gold ring the size of a half dollar that imbues Quarter Fall, a fall at a quarter of normal speed, and shoves the needle through his left nipple so Donut will wear the smallest. New Achievement: Sex Pervert. When the Recital quest completes, he drinks a Feather Fall potion anyway, distrusting the ring, and the world goes vroom.

beats.headline: Through the left nipple
beats.text: Of Iota's four nipple rings, two hold any real value. The biggest gives plus five to Drink Mixing, for bartenders; the next shows an item's average selling value; both are for selling. Carl groans at the third, because he will pretty much have to wear it: a glowing gold ring the size of a half dollar that imbues Quarter Fall, a fall at a quarter of the normal speed. Not a pleasant landing, but a survivable one, and better than the half-splat potions. Donut will wear the smallest ring only if he does his first, so he shoves the needle through his left nipple. New Achievement! Sex Pervert!
beats.gist: Carl and Donut sort Iota's nipple rings; Carl must wear the Quarter Fall one.

beats.headline: A fall ability, not trusted
beats.text: The Recital quest completes, and the Sledge sends his last message: five seconds, good-bye. All around them is blood and carnage and death. Carl meets Donut's eyes and shouts for potions. He has his nipple ring's fall ability, but he does not trust it, so he drinks a Feather Fall potion as well. Then the world goes vroom, and everything freezes.
beats.gist: Carl distrusts his nipple ring's fall ability, so he drinks a Feather Fall potion too before everything freezes.
